Kutuphane -> Calgi sayfasi -> Kurs -> Ders. Her calgi KENDI sayfasi.
DURUSTLUK KURALLARI (mekanik olarak test edilir, tools/validate_library.py):
1. status=coming_soon olan calgida KURS OLAMAZ (sahte kurs listelenmez).
2. Her kursun en az 1 dersi olmak zorunda (bos kurs listelenmez).
3. Ders, ruleset'te BULUNMAYAN teknige atif yapamaz.
4. Her calgida honesty bloku ZORUNLU (neler olculur / neler OLCULMEZ).
5. status=locked olan her ders lockedReason tasimak zorunda (esik degeri DEGIL, EKSIK OLCUMUN adi).
6. Kapsam-disi (comingSoonInThisDiscipline) her madde gerekce tasimak zorunda.

disciplines.blurb: Put your phone where it can see you sitting with your guitar. We check your sitting posture against how real teachers sit, and listen for the chords you play.

measured: Trunk alignment while sitting — checked against 7 independent guitar teachers who agree to within 2.24 degrees of each other (config/references/guitar-posture-setup.v1.json, ATTESTED)

Chord class for the 8 open chords this course covers — E A D G C Am Em Dm. A chord outside those 8 is refused by name ('not one of the chords this lesson covers'), not reported as the nearest one that is.
notMeasured: Arm and hand position while holding the guitar — teachers disagree about this by style (11-18 degrees apart), we show it but do not grade it (M-O-46)
Finger placement or fretting technique — camera cannot see fingers well enough to grade them yet

Strum timing — NOT measured. We can hear individual note attacks, but a strum is one gesture producing six near-simultaneous ones, and the step that maps those onto a chord does not exist yet. Until 2026-08-04 this line said 'measured, not yet graded'; that was wrong and the config carried a matching dead gate.
Full note-by-note transcription — we recognise the chord class, not every note played

Chords beyond those 8 — we do not name them. Until 2026-08-04 we did something worse than not naming them: a played Bb was reported as 'Dm' in 28 of 29 windows, confidently, because the engine was only allowed to consider the 8 chords of the drill. It now weighs all 24 chords and refuses when the winner is not one this lesson teaches.

courses.goal: Set up your space, sit correctly, and learn to hear when you're playing the right open chord.

lessons.lockedReason: We can see your arms but we deliberately do not grade them. The three teachers we measured hold the guitar 11-18 degrees apart from each other — that is style, not error, so there is no honest 'correct' to score you against. This lesson opens only if a measurement is found that separates style from mistake.

Nothing below your hips is measured. Our posture reference is built from upper-body landmarks only, because guitar teaching footage is filmed waist-up — knees and ankles are usually not in frame at all. Without leg landmarks we cannot tell a footstool from a crossed leg.

Chord recognition has only been proven on synthetic audio (8/8 chords, zero false judgements) — it hasn't been tested on a real guitar recording yet. We won't grade you against a measurement we haven't confirmed on a real instrument.

comingSoonInThisDiscipline: Strum timing as a graded skill — blocked twice over: the strum-to-chord alignment step is not built, and no teacher data exists on how far off the beat counts as a mistake

Arm/hand posture as a graded skill — the seven teachers we measured hold the guitar 39 to 105 degrees apart at the elbows and forearms. That is style and camera angle, not error; this may never become gradeable.

Named posture coaching (the 'you are slouching' cue) — the threshold is now derived from the reference (14 degrees, the spread inside which two teachers count as sitting the same way), but we have not yet decided whether a measurement can be spoken as a correction without a movement-science review.

disciplines._openSetFix: 2026-08-04 (M-O-67, fallback-canlılık reçetesi M-F-184 adım 5): ölçüm mekanizma A buldu — sözlük-dışı akorlar en yakın modellenmiş akora GÜVENLE tamamlanıyordu (Bb→Dm %97, Bm→D %76). Eşik oynatmak çözmüyordu: yanlış-etiketi yarıya indirmek gerçek akorların %61'ini kaybettiriyordu. Kök neden ADAY KÜMESİNİN daraltılmasıydı — kazanacak hipotez (Bb) listede yoktu, motor en yakınını seçmek zorundaydı. Düzeltme bedelsiz çıktı: aday 24, kabul 8 → yanlış-etiket %65,5→%0,0, tanıma kaybı değişmedi (%0,9). 'Open chords' dersi zaten kilitliydi, bu yüzden kusur kullanıcıya ULAŞMADI — ama dürüstlük kutusu canlıydı ve bu satırı taşımıyordu.

disciplines.blurb: Put your phone where it can see you from the waist up. We check how you hold yourself against six independent singing teachers — before you sing and while you sing.

Perde ve sustain motorlari GERCEK ve olculuyor, ama GERCEK BIR INSAN SESI kaydinda hic dogrulanmadi (bkz. sustained_note dersi, locked). measured: Trunk alignment, before you sing and while you sing — checked against 6 independent voice teachers who agree to within 1.35 degrees of each other (config/references/voice-posture-setup.v1.json, ATTESTED)
Whether the room is quiet enough and your voice is loud enough to judge at all (the gate refuses rather than guesses)
notMeasured: Pitch accuracy and steadiness while singing — the engine works and is measured, but it has only been confirmed on real CELLO audio, never on a real singing voice. Locked until it is (see the Sustained note lesson).
Vibrato — measured, never judged. We have no teacher data on what rate is 'right', and inventing one would be a guess dressed as a measurement.
Arm, shoulder and elbow position — the six teachers disagree with each other by 43 to 88 degrees on these. That is style and framing, not error, so we show them and never grade them.

Anything below your hips, and your head and jaw — voice teaching footage is filmed waist-up, so knees are usually not in frame, and our posture reference carries no head landmark. This is why we cannot name the posture mistakes teachers actually talk about (locked knees, lifted chin).
Breath support, larynx position, tongue root — not visible to a camera at all. They are in our error library and deliberately out of product scope.

lessons.lockedReason: The pitch engine is real and we can show you exactly what it measures — but it has only been confirmed on real cello recordings (48 segments, median error under 19 cents), never on a real singing voice. A voice is not a cello: vibrato, breath and formants are exactly the things that would break it. We will not grade your singing against a measurement we have not confirmed on singing. One real vocal recording through the same pipeline opens this lesson.
lessons._why_locked_detail: Fixture AF-001-clean-sustained-a4 SENTETIK. Motor gercek (YIN), olcum gercek, dogrulama gercek — ama girdi sentetik. Gitarin 'Open chords' dersiyle AYNI standart, ayni sekilde uygulandi. Fark: akor dedektorunun HIC gercek-ses dogrulamasi yok, perde kestiricinin BASKA bir calgida var.

EL GERI BILDIRIMI DIYE BIR SEY YOK — el/parmak landmark'i hic yok (P-WRIST-COLLAPSE ve P-FINGER-FLAT bu yuzden blockedByTool). measured: Trunk alignment while you sit — checked against 3 independent piano teachers who agree to within 1.09 degrees of each other, the tightest agreement of any instrument we have measured (config/references/piano-posture-setup.v1.json, ATTESTED)
Note timing against the beat — measured and shown to you, never graded (see below)
notMeasured: Note timing as a GRADE. We now measure it for real (AF-008-five-note-timing), and that measurement immediately showed why it cannot be graded yet: the engine reads a perfectly-on-beat note as 8.3 ms early, and that bias falls unevenly — the same 40 ms error reads as 49 ms when you rush and 31 ms when you drag. Grading on that would punish rushing harder than dragging for no musical reason.

Wrists, fingers and hand shape — we have no hand or finger landmarks at all, only body joints. Every hand-related mistake in our error library is blocked on that missing tool, not on a missing threshold.

Shoulder tension — the mistake teachers name most often for piano (5 independent channels). We can see shoulders but the three teachers' shoulder angles differ by 24 vs 5 degrees between left and right, and 'shoulders rising toward the ears' is a height, not the angle we hold. Naming it would be guessing.
Elbow distance from the body — measured, but the three teachers' elbow angles spread across 20 to 77 degrees. That is noise, not a threshold.
Bench height, pedalling, evenness of touch, note reading — either blocked on the same missing tools or outside what a camera can see.

lessons.lockedReason: We can hear every note you play and time it against the beat — you will see those numbers. What we cannot do is turn them into a mark. No piano teacher data exists on how far off the beat counts as a mistake, and our own timing engine reads a perfect note as 8.3 ms early with a bias that falls harder on rushing than on dragging. A grade built on that would be arithmetic, not teaching.
lessons._why_locked_detail: M-O-65: PLAY fazinin note_timing_ms quality kapisi INDIRILDI. Iki kusur ust usteydi — (1) kapi URETILMEYEN bir metrige bakiyordu (MetronomeAligner koduna hicbir fixture bagli degildi), (2) bar (50 ms) UYDURMAYDI. Simdi metrik gercekten olculuyor (AF-008) ama bar hala yok: postur referansi EKLEM olcer, zamanlama olcmez.
